content.content:
59efa8e8 CoverManager: Fix local cover art.
842d4e82 CoverManager: Properly close resources after use.
3b43497b cover: Initialize the result with null, don't return early.
03bd8e4b cover: Use getInputStream() inline where it makes sense.
22d6d89c cover: Add a new method to check url status by connection, rather than status.
5def9202 cover: Check the status code directly after requesting it.
184de3ff cover: Move HTTP connection building to it's own method.
144f7046 AbstractWebCover: Move the URL build out of executeGetRequestWithConnection().
4ce47a03 cover: Abstract out HTTP status code checking.
8ad45e48 dmix: Remove redundant initializers.
d5f147af dmix: Remove redundant boolean conditionals.
8c66c136 MPDroid: Remove redundant casts.
dc234fa1 MPDroid: Remove unnecessary semicolons.
b602aa80 Add useful cover art debug info
b4bcc624 Add copyright header to most java files in the repository.
495bb93f Fix some warnings
f4cbbff4 Reindent, reorder impent and reorder members of MPDroid.
00fbcf4b Use GraceNote for covers only if the user set one. - Request quota exceeded for the shared gracenote ID. - Fix a NPE in covermanager
b53f9d2b Add cover debug : Display cover retriever name When the CoverManager is in DEBUG mode the cover retriever name (Lastfm ...) is displayed as a notification (toast)
036ba567 Add a cover fetcher for Itunes Change cover fetcher priority Put it in second place because we now have access to good quality images. Since it is in second position do not fallback on low quality images in case of failure with the high res image.
2de0dad6 Add a cover fetcher for Itunes Change cover fetcher priority
9a4fa8ac Add a cover fetcher for Itunes Change cover fetcher priority
32744a32 Add a cover fetcher for Itunes May be a replacement for GraceNote but the image quality is not huge (200X200).
022d196c Improve album cover fetching - Try once to fetch the cover then in case of failures re-try with a normalized name for artist and album (removing special characters ...) - Exclude the cache and locale fetcher from this - Refactor this check to be done in the CoverManager.
de4b7160 Remove dead code.
af57a686 Fix locale cover fetching Do not mark a cover art as not found if the path is not set.
f13a63b9 Do not try again to find not found album covers up to next runtime Fix reset cover (the not found cover list was allowed to contained several times an album key and the reset cover just removed one of them)
e7da7e2e Do not try again to find not found album covers up to next runtime.
8ae4f798 Revert "Improve cover request robustness : Let the cover manager triggers the cover view tag with the album key."
9555f3ec Improve cover request robustness : Let the cover manager triggers the cover view tag with the album key. Avoid the use of a different album key to tag the view (in case of album key mismatch the cover notifications are ignored by the cover listeners)
519e8c64 Minor improvement for AlbumInfo - Use the AlbumInfo check in the cover manager. - Simplify getKey()
1244d61f Improve cover fetching speed Factorize cover download requests even if their priorities are different. Allows to factorize requests from the nowplaying fragment (high priority) and from the playlist (normal priority)
548a1922 Fix #327 : List cover art progress bar spins forever - Cover progress bar display is now triggered by the message "onCoverDownloadStarted" sent by the cover manager. - The cover is then displayed by the album cover listener when it receives the onCoverDownloadStarted message. - The cover manager sends the onCoverDownloadStarted message when the cover is downloaded from the web (no progress bar when the cover comes from the cache)
a2becfea Use the android TextUtils method instead of the custom StringsUtils.isNullOrEmpty()
5fa3ecd0 Improve Playlist for streams
b008da87 Refactor cover download API : use AlbumInfo everywhere
a6102796 Simplify cover API : Remove the cacheOnly parameter. Make the API simpler and was always set to false.
d6936af5 Improve save wrong cover list --> Do not save it at every request.
28d0853a Hack to be able to blacklist covers from gracenote The gracenote URL change at every request. Match only on the URL prefix for this provider. Example : Cover downloaded for Montreux Jazzfest, Switzerland CD 1 from http://web.content.cddbp.net/cds/2.0?id=2AFFDA687D4BA3CD&client=15942656&class=cover&origin=front&size=large&type=image/jpeg&tag=02jbM70SG7Y2munTeB4JU4eJvJ8NzpiuyxanqgOO2MKcQ0RhTOeVkCcA, size=47801 Cover downloaded for Montreux Jazzfest, Switzerland CD 1 from http://web.content.cddbp.net/cds/2.0?id=2AFFDA687D4BA3CD&client=15942656&class=cover&origin=front&size=large&type=image/jpeg&tag=02v6k0TAv2eZ.xjTmnn58IcSUhNErL8mzrQdbSxIZXAoWMRLH97dHVHQ, size=47801
f500c628 Add an entry in the cover popup menu to reset image data for the current album (reset black list ...)
a9105332 Blacklist wrong cover - A long click on the cover opens a menu with an item "Other image ..." to blacklist the current cover  image url and try to load a new one. The cover urls and blacklisted cover urls are stored in two files in the cover directory  : covers.bin, wrong-covers.bin These 2 files can be removed with  the clean cover cache existing method.
fba67a0d Limit web cover requests (for big playlists scrolling) Discard oldest web cover requests when a maximum size has been reached Avoid to overload the web cover request queue when scrolling a big playlist. Efficient enough without having to get the scrolling status
a5a47609 Fix for : Playlist item covers may get mixed up when items have the same title. => Add artist + album to the item view tag to avoid confusion.
8fcb7c27 Refactore code that tags album cover with artist and album Make it more robust to changes
b57cd652 Fix for  The wrong cover art gets saved many times for my albums (Fix for #288) Fix the check on album and artist names : an "unknown artist" triggered cover fetching and saved the wrong cover for cases you do not know the artist (all albums view)
d6c433d4 1.6 source level
f6d5204c - Use the enableAlbumArtLibrary property to enable/disable the cover web fetching from the playlist fragment. - Minor improve not to regroup requests with different priority or retrievers
be1da3a4 Little robusteness improvements : - Add a way to stop the cover executors - Do not process requests without album or artist
e7d2354c Little robusteness improvements
a3cd9e90 Fix cover manager - Fix concurrency problems by putting the listeners inside the coverinfo - Fix bitmap sharing problem with recycling (make a copy first)

## Bug-Introducing Commits
BIC: 842d4e82f6ec5b9abf8e4e51efb80c76ceac7214

## Reasoning

**(1) Investigation:** I traced the history of `CoverManager.java`'s `getCoverBytes()` method with `git log -p --follow`, since the fix adds a `break;` inside the loop over `coverUrls`. I located the method's original introduction (commit `7bf261a6`), where the loop used `return coverBytes;` immediately after a successful download — functionally equivalent to a `break`, since it stops the loop as soon as a cover is found.

**(2) The introducing change:** Commit `842d4e82` ("CoverManager: Properly close resources after use") was primarily meant to add proper `finally`-block resource cleanup to the `download()` helper method (closing `BufferedInputStream`/`ByteArrayOutputStream`). However, as an incidental part of that same diff, it also removed the line:
```
-                    return coverBytes;
```
from inside the `getCoverBytes()` loop, without replacing it with a `break;`. This left the loop with no early-exit mechanism at all — it would keep iterating over the remaining `coverUrls` even after successfully obtaining cover bytes, potentially overwriting `coverBytes` with `null` (or a different/wrong result) on later iterations, notably affecting local cache-file covers (`CACHE_COVER_FETCH`).

**(3) Supporting evidence:** The bug-fixing commit `59efa8e8` re-adds exactly one line, `break;`, at the same location in `getCoverBytes()` — the loop-exit statement that `842d4e82` had deleted. The diff context (`"Cover downloaded for " + coverInfo.getAlbum() ...`) is identical in both commits, confirming they touch the same code path. No other commit in the file's history removes or omits this loop-terminating behavior, and the commit message/title of `842d4e82` ("properly close resources") shows the removal of `return coverBytes;` was an unrelated, likely inadvertent side effect of that refactor rather than an intentional behavior change — consistent with it being the source of the "local cover art" bug fixed a month later.

I'm fairly confident in this identification given the direct line-level correspondence between the removed `return` and the added `break`, though I can't independently confirm the author's intent beyond what the diffs show.

**(1) Investigation:** I traced the history of `CoverManager.java`'s `getCoverBytes()` method with `git log -p --follow`, since the fix adds a `break;` inside the loop over `coverUrls`. I located the method's original introduction (commit `7bf261a6`), where the loop used `return coverBytes;` immediately after a successful download — functionally equivalent to a `break`, since it stops the loop as soon as a cover is found.

**(2) The introducing change:** Commit `842d4e82` ("CoverManager: Properly close resources after use") was primarily meant to add proper `finally`-block resource cleanup to the `download()` helper method (closing `BufferedInputStream`/`ByteArrayOutputStream`). However, as an incidental part of that same diff, it also removed the line:
```
-                    return coverBytes;
```
from inside the `getCoverBytes()` loop, without replacing it with a `break;`. This left the loop with no early-exit mechanism at all — it would keep iterating over the remaining `coverUrls` even after successfully obtaining cover bytes, potentially overwriting `coverBytes` with `null` (or a different/wrong result) on later iterations, notably affecting local cache-file covers (`CACHE_COVER_FETCH`).

**(3) Supporting evidence:** The bug-fixing commit `59efa8e8` re-adds exactly one line, `break;`, at the same location in `getCoverBytes()` — the loop-exit statement that `842d4e82` had deleted. The diff context (`"Cover downloaded for " + coverInfo.getAlbum() ...`) is identical in both commits, confirming they touch the same code path.
